messages:
incident_bot: ALERT — spike in 429s for org `Vellum` detected (region: us-west1). 5xxs normal, but org-level rate limit hitting. link: https://grafana.redwood/v/alerts/3501236789 :rotating_light:
jonathan_oncall: paging in, oncall here. looking at grafana now. anyone on-call for capacity?
luis_infra: i'm online, seeing a sustained QPS increase from Vellum ~x6 baseline, token usage up. Their prefix cache hit is OK.
emma_support: Vellum CS just DMed — users seeing timeouts and job failures. impact: web UI search and realtime suggestions.
paul_prod: quick ask — can we temporarily raise their org cap to relieve 429s while we investigate root cause? prefer short window (15–30m) then reassess.
jonathan_oncall: agree. plan: 1) emergency per-org qps bump 2) disable nonessential realtime path (autocomplete) for Vellum if bump insufficient 3) monitor latency & errors 4) notify CS and customer.
karen_ops: +1. Also prepare rollback steps and keep an eye on dedicated pool saturation.
luis_infra: prepared command. will run if we have consensus. ```bash
# increase Vellum soft QPS (temporary)
redwoodctl org update-rate --org vellum --soft-qps 18 --duration 30m
```
paul_prod: confirm that 18 qps stays within pooled headroom?
luis_infra: yes — current cluster headroom ~25 qps spare, will add a circuit-breaker if CPU > 85%.
jonathan_oncall: go ahead, luis. call it out when done and include request id.
sre_bot: Received command: redwoodctl exec queued. executing on infra-ops. request_id=rb-3501236791
luis_infra: ran command — request_id=rb-3501236791 — API responded 200. soft-qps now 18 for vellum.
emma_support: notified Vellum CSM (Laura) — telling them we applied a temporary cap increase and are monitoring.
paul_prod: seeing 429 rate drop in grafana. 429s down ~70% in last 40s. nice.
jonathan_oncall: excellent. keep watching latency P50/P95 and GPU utilization.
karen_ops: also enable traffic-shaping to favor steady small requests over bursts. patch command: ```json
{"policy":"org-vellum-burst-suppress","action":"leaky-bucket","rate":15}
```
luis_infra: applied policy, id=tsh-3501236805. burst smoothing shows immediate effect on tail latency.
sre_bot: Metric check: P95 latency now stable, GPU util increased by ~6%. No node OOMs.\oncall_note: jonathan_oncall -> will shadow for next 20m, then hand off to karen_ops for overnight if still unstable.
paul_prod: what's our rollback if this causes cluster pressure?
luis_infra: rollback steps: 1) run `redwoodctl org update-rate --org vellum --soft-qps 10` 2) disable soft bump policy 3) route Vellum to secondary region (if primary saturated) — I can coordinate.
jonathan_oncall: copy. tagging @karen_ops for handoff at +20m. karen, please take the escalation if it persists.
karen_ops: ack. will be on deck. I'll keep CS updated and prep a short incident blurb for the customer.
emma_support: support note drafted: "We detected elevated request volume causing temporary throttling; we've applied a short-term capacity increase while investigating. We'll follow up with root cause and timeline." Sending to Laura now.
paul_prod: any sign of malicious traffic or a loop from their side?
luis_infra: looking at request signatures — looks like a batch job on their side retrying aggressively after client-side timeouts. not clearly malicious.
jonathan_oncall: ask Vellum to throttle back retries if possible. Emma, can CS ask them to pause that batch job for 10–15m?
emma_support: on it. Laura is asking engineering to pause.
paul_prod: great. once retries paused, we can start reducing soft-qps back toward normal.
sre_bot: periodic check @ 3501236825 — 429s continue to trend down, request rate for Vellum falling to 2.1x baseline.
luis_infra: i'm going to set an autoscale guard: if combined spare headroom < 10 qps, alert and auto-rollback bump. command: ```bash
redwoodctl guard create --name vellum-bump-guard --threshold 10 --on-breach rollback-vellum-bump
```
\oncall_note: jonathan_oncall -> will remain until handoff window; otherwise karen_ops takes.
jonathan_oncall: after 15m of stability I'll reduce bump to 12 qps for 10m then to normal.
karen_ops: noted. will post final status update when I take over.
paul_prod: thanks all. quick postmortem items: better per-org retry guidelines, CS playbook update, automated safe-bump with guard.
incident_bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — mitigation applied: per-org soft-qps increased, traffic shaping policy applied, CS notified. Monitoring for 30m.
jonathan_oncall: closing the page for immediate action — handoff to karen_ops in 18m. everyone: thumbs if your okay with the plan :thumbsup:
luis_infra: :thumbsup:
karen_ops: :thumbsup:
paul_prod: :thumbsup:
emma_support: :thumbsup:
sre_bot: :thumbsup:
incident_bot: NOTE — thread archived in 72h unless flagged.
